deck.note: Official Deck chosen by default for its game when the API launches it. The player can pick another installed Deck or Off in game; that choice wins for this player, game and mode.

native.note: Super Mario World as snes9x gives it (256 x 224 shown 4:3). 1920 x 1080: game 1440 x 1080 pushed right, rail 480 px = 106 game pixels; 1920 x 1200: game 1600 x 1200, rail 320 px = 64 game pixels, drawn at half the game pixel when the plates need it. The rail is always filled.

placement.note: Game pushed right at full screen height (no black band), one rail on the left: the speedrun column, as LiveSplit puts it beside the game.

provenance.author: NelfePlay
provenance.license: CC BY 4.0 (tile, plates, digits and layout drawn for NelfePlay; no image, sprite, logo or font taken from the game)
provenance.palette: Colours picked (no pixel copied) from the game's screens produced by snes9x: Yoshi Island sky and hills (#73b6d5 #c5e6e6 #4185a4 #105073), ground (#cd9d5a #7b6918), HUD yellow #e6c652, green #00ce00.

digits.note: Digits redrawn for NelfePlay in the style of the game's own figures; colours per row picked from the game's screens. No pixel copied.

recipe.title: SUPER MARIO WORLD
recipe.subtitle: SPEEDRUN

trial.note: Speedrun column (pattern F): TIME (official time of the trial, gaps to PB, world record and target rank), SPLITS (segments of the run against the best finished attempt of the session, or the PB splits the API publishes), RUN (the validity of the run: rules watched live in green, rules checked at certification in grey), then the game's own resources; LIVE RANK last.

notes: SPLITS: level runs in two segments, start to the midway point, midway point to the goal, against the best finished attempt of this session (computed).
MARIO: power form, dragon coins of the level, lives (shown as the game shows them).
